chapters.label: Overnight
chapters.text: SDAL-0405 (OLT_DAV_207 fibre cut) has been open since 23:42 with a crew assigned.

chapters.label: 06:00 Shift opens
chapters.text: One map, eight territories; every feed on time.

chapters.label: 06:07 A cluster forms
chapters.text: Three customers on CAV_118_L004_N07B; no alarm. The Investigator watches but abstains: the WMS batch has not landed.

chapters.label: 06:12 SDAL-0412 proposed
chapters.text: Optical Rx below -27 dBm on 11 of 14 gateways since 05:48. NAP-level fibre fault, support 0.86.

chapters.label: 06:15 Dispatch reacts
chapters.text: Suppress on the incident's orders, dispatch on a CPE signature next door; planned works and power shown as unavailable.

chapters.label: 06:30 Queue re-ranks
chapters.text: SDAL-0412 above the older OLT incident SDAL-0405: no crew yet, and its window breaches first.

chapters.label: 06:40 Silent majority
chapters.text: 14 recipients, 10 of them silent. Approved as a draft; nothing is sent.

chapters.label: 06:45 Feed stall
chapters.text: Handyman stops arriving. Late, then stalled; detectors that depend on it pause.

chapters.label: 07:10 Restoration
chapters.text: Rx back to -20 dBm; closure proposed and confirmed.

chapters.label: 07:30 The question
chapters.chat: Which NAPs had three or more repeat orders this week with no SNOW incident?
chapters.text: Answered from curated rows, with citations.

chapters.label: 07:32 Flapping NAP
chapters.text: Short repeat SNOW tickets rolled into one recurring-fault incident; scored on lines, not ticket count.

chapters.label: 08:30 Hold expires
chapters.text: The 2-hour hold-and-recheck becomes a dispatch: nothing new arrived.

scenarios.title: Non-alarm NAP fibre fault
scenarios.takeaway: Non-alarm faults are found from the customer side, with evidence, before the hourly cycle.

scenarios.title: Single-line CPE fault next door
scenarios.takeaway: The system does not over-suppress; a customer-side signature rolls a truck.

scenarios.title: OLT outage already in SNOW
scenarios.takeaway: Existing outages are linked, never duplicated; the queue explains itself.

scenarios.title: Stale evidence, silent gateway
scenarios.takeaway: Hold is a time-boxed decision with a recheck, not a quiet cancellation.

scenarios.title: Handyman feed stall
scenarios.takeaway: Missing data is an alert, never evidence of calm.

scenarios.title: Flapping NAP
scenarios.takeaway: Globe's known data quirks are handled, not hidden.

tool_registry.name: ticket_cluster_read
tool_registry.doc: Open repair orders on an element inside the rolling window.

tool_registry.name: telemetry_read
tool_registry.doc: Rx and Tx per gateway on the element over the window, converted to dBm.

tool_registry.name: topology_lookup
tool_registry.doc: Resolve NAP to LCP and OLT (effective-dated) and count siblings.

tool_registry.name: sibling_health
tool_registry.doc: Latest optical median and open-order count for each sibling of the element.

tool_registry.name: exposure_calc
tool_registry.reads: subscriber bases, product mapping, WMS keys
tool_registry.doc: Observed lines (orders or Handyman complaints), inferred lines (no contact), VIP/B2B count, MSF band totals.

tool_registry.name: incident_registry.search
tool_registry.doc: Open, or resolved in the last 6 hours, incidents on the same NAP or any ancestor element.

tool_registry.name: incident_registry.create
tool_registry.doc: Write a new incident object with state Proposed.

tool_registry.name: incident_registry.merge
tool_registry.doc: Record a duplicate cluster as Merged into an existing incident and refresh the parent.

tool_registry.name: incident_registry.close
tool_registry.doc: Propose closure (optical back to baseline, no new orders for 30 minutes).

tool_registry.name: incident_registry_read
tool_registry.doc: Open incident whose element is upstream of (or equal to) the line's NAP.

tool_registry.name: planned_works_check
tool_registry.doc: No planned-works source in the pilot: returns unknown, never clear.

tool_registry.name: power_footprint_check
tool_registry.doc: No power-outage footprint source in the pilot: returns unknown, never clear.

tool_registry.name: line_history_read
tool_registry.doc: Prior orders on the line. Free-text fields are returned as data and scanned for instruction-like content.

tool_registry.name: symptom_signature_check
tool_registry.doc: Customer-side signature from Handyman (ModemStatus, LineStatus, PortStatus, optics) and WMS (gateway Rx, reporting).

tool_registry.name: adoption_record_write
tool_registry.doc: Append one recommendation and its human decision.

tool_registry.name: queue_read
tool_registry.doc: Current queue members: Proposed/Confirmed incidents plus dispatch-eligible orders outside any incident.

tool_registry.name: sla_clock
tool_registry.doc: Clock start = earliest createdate among the item's open orders; breach = start + 6h.

tool_registry.name: ranking_explain
tool_registry.doc: Explain why item a is above item b from their recorded inputs.

tool_registry.name: crew_availability_read
tool_registry.doc: Crew assigned from the static team field / SNOW assignment group. Live crew availability is unavailable in the pilot.

tool_registry.name: subscriber_resolve
tool_registry.doc: All subscribers on the element, split observed (called or ran Handyman) from inferred (silent).

tool_registry.name: restoration_target_read
tool_registry.doc: Globe's published restoration target if outage management has one. The platform never computes its own ETA.

tool_registry.name: contact_policy_check
tool_registry.doc: Quiet hours, frequency cap, cross-incident dedupe, consent (unavailable in pilot) per recipient.

tool_registry.name: notification_package_build
tool_registry.doc: Template-based English text; identifiers stay pseudonymised.

tool_registry.name: ng1_handoff
tool_registry.writes: the single external write; disabled in demo
tool_registry.doc: The only external write in the design. Disabled: no code path in the demo calls it.

tool_registry.name: reply_capture_read
tool_registry.doc: Placeholder for m360 delivery and reply signal (pending the m360/ISDP decision).

tool_registry.name: curated_query
tool_registry.reads: curated orders, SNOW, topology, queue_rank (read-only views)
tool_registry.doc: Parameterised read-only queries behind the conversational panel; every answer cites the rows it returns.

tool_registry.name: feed_health_read
tool_registry.doc: Expected-arrival status per source.
